caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, beige background. The object appears to be a decorative or ornamental piece rendered in shades of gold and brown. Its main body is elongated and vertically oriented, with symmetrical details on each side. At the top, there is a stylized horse head facing to the right, containing a circular cut-out surrounded by decorative lines. Beneath the horse head, the object widens slightly and displays incised patterns including curved lines, semicircles, and zigzag motifs. On each side of the central band, there are two pairs of round, radial designs, and below each pair, there is a serpentine motif running along the object’s edge. The bottom edge is asymmetrical, sweeping sharply downward to the left and narrowing to a point. The object also contains fine etched line work, and small dots or rivet shapes are depicted near the base. The overall color scheme is gold with darker brown accents used to emphasize the details, and the artist’s signature, “Albert Leroux”, is written in black ink at the bottom left of the image.
title: Patch Box of Kentucky Rifle
